sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000041-P1, was presented by PFIZER (the Supplier) to Prairie Pediatric Center 041 on January 5, 2026.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: a Tier 3 rebate of 4.5%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a commitment of 350 Pneumococcal doses per year.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: awaiting a Customer decision.
